summary: newcleo plc filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated October 14, 2026, announcing the inauguration of FASTER, an advanced nuclear fuel engineering, testing and training center in Chusclan, Occitanie, France. The facility represents an investment of approximately €10 million and houses seven operational test facilities supporting the company's MOX fuel manufacturing program. The filing is a routine operational milestone disclosure by a foreign private issuer; it involves no securities transaction, no change of control, no shareholder action, and no special-situations event. The deal-arb angle is inapplicable.
